[SWS_CRYPT_01208]
{DRAFT}
⌈
If the signature object is produced by a plain hash-
function then the dependence
COUID
of the signature should be set to
COUID
of the
used context. But the hash algorithm ID field of the signature should be set according
to the used algorithm ID.
⌋
